import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L = np.log(1+params[3]*eps)
    return params[0]*np.exp(params[1]*T) + params[2]*L*np.exp(params[4]*T) + params[5]*eps + params[6]*np.exp(params[7]*T)*L*T
